# gyro_reseller_customer (Resource)

A reseller (bayi) end-customer. Deleting it revokes its keys and webhooks; services stay on the reseller account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reseller (bayi) accounts only
resource "gyro_reseller_customer" "acme" {
  name         = "Acme Ltd"
  external_ref = "acme-001"
  allow_order  = true # Acme's keys may order servers, paid from YOUR balance at your discount
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `allow_order` (Boolean) May this customer's keys order servers (paid from the reseller balance)?
- `external_ref` (String) Your own customer id (unique per reseller).
- `status` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_reseller_customer.acme 7
```
